desc: Implement robust input parsing for N and A (contiguous or whitespace-separated bits).
Implement bottom-up value+flip-cost DP over the ternary majority tree using compact arrays/bytearray for N up to 13.

Combine triples: parent value = majority of child values; parent flip cost = sum of the two smallest child costs to become the parent's opposite value (0 if the child already has it, otherwise the child's flip cost).
Output the root flip cost and run sample tests/edge cases; if failures occur, switch to an explicit two-cost DP or debug.
